title: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP and ABAP Platform does not properly initialize memory in… (CVE-2026-109796)
description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP and ABAP Platform contain a vulnerability where memory is not properly initialized in certain internal components. This flaw could allow an attacker with low privileges to disclose uninitialized memory contents, impacting confidentiality with no effect on integrity or availability. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.3.
